criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 21 February 2027 (12 months after the 21 February 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the long-stop date as 26 May 2026 (150 days after signing on 27 December 2025) and identifies that expected clearance on 10 July 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Arden Software Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $254,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $253,180,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (21 February 2027), with days remaining from 9 January 2026 (408 days).
Notes that 21 February 2027 is a Sunday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 22 February 2027.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
